title: CR60013: Vacuum Techniques
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic concepts of vacuum – Classification of vacuum ranges and flow regimes Pumping Speed, throughput and conductance concepts, conductance calculations in
viscous and molecular flow conditions - Physical and chemical phenomena in
vacuum systems - Production of medium, high and ultra high vacuum - Pressure
measurement in vacuum systems, residual gas analysis - Materials and components
for vacuum and high vacuum systems – Fabrication of vacuum chambers/systems Leak detection and troubleshooting of vacuum systems - Applications of vacuum
Technology in metallurgy, electronics, food and pharmaceutical industries Ultra high vacuum in space simulation and nuclear technology - Super insulated
vacuum containers and transfer lines for storage/transfer of cryogenic fluids
